articles.summary: TORONTO, Canada – December 8, 2025 – Fury Gold Mines Limited (TSX: FURY, NYSE American: FURY) (“Fury” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce an initial inferred mineral resource estimate (“MRE”) for the La Pointe Extension target on its wholly owned Sakami gold project (“Sakami” or the “Project”), located in the Eeyou Istchee Territory in the James Bay region of […]
